crop.notes: Long column of racing tips, bicycle races, Henley regatta, McAuliffe challenge and tennis; only the three-line 'Sporting Notes' item near the bottom is about Allen.

ocr.notes: Surrounding items mostly readable, but the Allen notice itself is garbled ('To ILEN, Tf champion p').

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a sporting note for Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, at 619 Market Street: free concert every evening, first-class singers only.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, July 8, 1893, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen, styled retired champion pugilist of the world, ran a saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with a free concert every evening and first-class singers only

notes: Notice text: 'Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, 619 Market street; free concert every evening. First-class singers only engaged here.' Same notice as article 891.
